_comment: The model roster, declared once. Array order is display order. `dir` is the run directory (runs/<combo>/<dir>) and the key every analyser uses. Three independent flags, because they answer different questions: `latest` = the current-generation division on the verified card; `contender` = appears on the cross-meet cards and the overview (Opus 4.8 stays a contender while it is still the only Opus with data in multi/multilingual/pro); `effort` = supports adaptive thinking, so can carry an effort sweep. `tier` groups a lineage curve.
_effort: `effortLevels` is the ladder THAT model actually has, not a shared one: Anthropic offers five, Kimi K3 offers three (low/high/max), and assuming the Anthropic ladder for everyone would silently run identical legs under different names. `defaultEffort` is the level the main leg runs at when no effort is pinned — `high` for Anthropic, but `max` for Kimi K3, so the sweep must not claim main is `high` for it.
